context.summary: migrate_state currently uses one setdefault with a complete weights dict; if a v2 state already has a partial weights mapping, newly introduced dimensions can remain absent and later fitness calculation can fail.

objective: Make evolution-state weight migration forward-compatible when DIMENSIONS gains a new entry: keep any existing weights, initialize the weights mapping if absent, and set a default 1.0 only for dimensions that are missing.

outputs.description: Unverified candidate patch against the frozen source revision.
